Persistent multi-session price deterioration alongside continued breadth weakness, negative settled flows and ongoing supply contraction would establish a downside edge.

supporting_evidence: Most fast evidence describes one rebound hour and a weak trailing 24h period; it does not establish a week-long trend.

The small-alt proxy's approximately -0.28% equal-weight return masks a median near -2.05% and an advance ratio near 19.6%; large individual gainers do not demonstrate broad recovery.
The structural prior offers conditional recovery or retest-failure scenarios, not verified timing. It does not resolve the conflicting evidence.
